body:
Add optional FFTW wisdom caching and correct batching in the existing FFT backends.

## Standard information about the request

This is a: new feature, bug fix and efficiency update.

This change affects: the Python interfaces used by search and inference.

This change: includes focused regressions and follows the repository contribution workflow. Torch remains optional; no low-level C or Cython sources are changed in the main stack.

This change changes: Python implementation and its numerical/interface regression tests.

This change will: retain the optional Torch dependency introduced by #5.

## Motivation

Existing FFT users need batch transforms that preserve layout and output semantics, plus reusable FFTW planning information across runs.

## Contents

Automatic FFTW wisdom lifecycle and CLI integration, plus general NumPy/CuPy/cuFFT batching fixes. These independently useful changes are separated from the Torch implementation.

These pre-existing general FFT fixes remain an optional follow-up, separate from the main Torch conversion, whose default CPU behavior is preserved. The wisdom retry also holds the planner lock.

## Links to any issues or associated PRs

Depends on [#19](https://github.com/xangma/pycbc/pull/19). Optional leaf; separate from main-stack scientific qualification. PR #20 is withdrawn from this stack.

Base: `torch-fft-formatting-base`. Head: `torch-followup-fft-optimizations` at `8edcd6fece317f9e1c9a2f24656050c18e97ff34`.

Unchanged original CPU reference: `40e94792b3edf59f39b18b65102b28a4f74433a7`.

[Campaign and test evidence](https://github.com/xangma/pycbc/tree/31039e44d35ece9c6d755bd265c854d2bd8bb6a6/original-cpu-restoration); [tested-source mapping and documentation checks](https://github.com/xangma/pycbc/tree/a5d237cb4f4ed7a4e26d6b8ffa4aa0c1fc7b2964/original-cpu-restoration/final-publication).

## Testing performed

Separate optional-leaf validation: **348 passed, 16 skipped**, plus **5 native FFTW probes passed**. These checks cover the rebuilt FFTW wisdom/batching implementation; they do not establish full-search scientific equivalence for this optional leaf.

Completed main-stack campaign at `aa6b795a63bb18c4e63e4f4c203ca6e7c039d0f0` (separate from this optional leaf's validation): **CPU preservation PASS, 1988 = 1988 triggers**; all 18 scientific H1 datasets and full PSD arrays are byte-identical, with matching geometry. Conditioned-strain identity is verified by full-data SHA256 and metadata; raw conditioned strain was not archived.

**Torch CPU and Torch CUDA: 1991 triggers each, FAIL** against both CPU controls under unchanged trigger/full-PSD gates. Only four recorded runtime/timing fields are excluded; raw and corrected verdicts are retained. No performance samples or speedup claim.
